column1: DENGUE CASE REPORTING During  the  28th  week,  7633  suspected  dengue  cases were reported across all 26 districts, compared to 7891 cases in the previous week, reflecting an 3.3% decrease. The  Western  Province  accounted  for  53.6%  of  total cases,  with the  Colombo  Municipal  Council (CMC) contributing 3.5%, the rest of Colombo District 17.8%, Gampaha  District  24.1%,  and  Kalutara  District  8.1%. Outside the Western Province, notable case contributions were reported from Kandy (8.7%), Matara (6.1%),  Galle  (5.7%),  Ratnapura  (5%),  Kurunegala (2.8%),  Puttalam  (2.5%)  Kegalle  (2.4%),  Hambantota (2.4%), and Badulla (2.3%) (see Table 1).
